subject: [RFC PATCH 14/18] mm/filemap: read from the page cache without folio references

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch optimizes small file reads by allowing the page cache to be accessed without taking a reference on the folio, reducing the overhead of reference counting and improving performance. It achieves this by copying data from folios that are about to be freed under RCU read lock protection, and leaving large or problematic folios to the slow path for handling. The patch also limits the amount of data copied in each section to 512 KiB and skips files that have never had a flagged folio or are writably mapped.
